import os,glob,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def norm(cells):
    ra=min(a for a,b in cells); ca=min(b for a,b in cells)
    return tuple(sorted((a-ra,b-ca) for a,b in cells))

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    zc=[j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j]==0 for i in range(h))]
    lw=zc[0]
    left=[row[:lw] for row in grid]
    right=[[row[j] for j in range(zc[0]+1,w)] for row in grid]
    rw=len(right[0]); fc=left[0][0]
    full=[i for i in range(h) if all(v==fc for v in left[i])]
    zfull=[i for i in range(h) if all(v==0 for v in right[i])]
    shapes={}
    i=0
    while i<h:
        if i in zfull: i+=1; continue
        j=i
        while j<h and j not in zfull: j+=1
        cells=[(a,b) for a in range(i,j) for b in range(rw) if right[a][b]!=0]
        col=Counter(right[a][b] for a,b in cells).most_common(1)[0][0]
        shapes[norm(cells)]=col
        i=j
    out=[row[:] for row in left]
    for k in range(len(full)-1):
        top,bot=full[k],full[k+1]
        cells=[(a,b) for a in range(top+1,bot) for b in range(lw) if out[a][b]==0]
        for a,b in cells: out[a][b]=shapes[norm(cells)]
    return out

    """Fill each frame slab's holes with the color of the right-side shape matching the hole pattern."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    zc = [j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j] == 0 for i in range(h))]
    lw = zc[0]
    left = [row[:lw] for row in grid]
    right = [[row[j] for j in range(zc[0]+1, w)] for row in grid]
    rw = len(right[0]); fc = left[0][0]
    full = [i for i in range(h) if all(v == fc for v in left[i])]
    zfull = [i for i in range(h) if all(v == 0 for v in right[i])]
    shapes = {}
    i = 0
    while i < h:
        if i in zfull: i += 1; continue
        j = i
        while j < h and j not in zfull: j += 1
        cells = [(a, b) for a in range(i, j) for b in range(rw) if right[a][b] != 0]
        col = Counter(right[a][b] for a, b in cells).most_common(1)[0][0]
        shapes[lib.normalize(cells)] = col
        i = j
    out = [row[:] for row in left]
    for k in range(len(full)-1):
        top, bot = full[k], full[k+1]
        cells = [(a, b) for a in range(top+1, bot) for b in range(lw) if out[a][b] == 0]
        for a, b in cells: out[a][b] = shapes[lib.normalize(cells)]
    return out

def split_gap(grid, bg=0):
    """Split a grid into left and right parts at the first all-background column (right part excludes it)."""
    w=len(grid[0])
    j=next(j for j in range(w) if all(r[j]==bg for r in grid))
    return [r[:j] for r in grid], [[r[k] for k in range(j+1,w)] for r in grid]

def frame_rows(grid, fc):
    """Row indices that are entirely the frame color fc."""
    return [i for i in range(len(grid)) if all(v==fc for v in grid[i])]

def shape_groups(grid, bg=0):
    """Row blocks of non-background separated by all-background rows, as (cells, color) with cells relative to the block's top-left."""
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    zfull=[i for i in range(h) if all(v==bg for v in grid[i])]
    out={}; i=0
    while i<h:
        if i in zfull: i+=1; continue
        j=i
        while j<h and j not in zfull: j+=1
        cells=[(a,b) for a in range(i,j) for b in range(w) if grid[a][b]!=bg]
        col=Counter(grid[a][b] for a,b in cells).most_common(1)[0][0]
        out[normalize(cells)]=col
        i=j
    return out

def fill_holes_by_shape(grid):
    """Left frame block: fill each slab's holes with the color of the matching shape from the right part."""
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    left,right=split_gap(grid)
